metadata.disclaimer: DEMONSTRATION DATASET ONLY - NOT A VALIDATED RESEARCH BENCHMARK. Designed solely for unit testing and verifying evaluation metrics pipeline functionality.

format_documentation.sample_id: Unique string identifier for the evaluation test case
format_documentation.question: Evaluation prompt or user inquiry string
format_documentation.reference_answer: Ground-truth factual answer written by human annotators
format_documentation.expected_source: Optional document ID string where supporting evidence resides
format_documentation.expected_pages: Optional list of 1-indexed page numbers where facts are located
format_documentation.document_id: Document identifier in vector store collection
format_documentation.relevant_doc_ids: Optional list of document IDs containing ground-truth evidence
format_documentation.supporting_passages: Optional list of raw verbatim passages containing evidence
format_documentation.metadata: Optional arbitrary key-value metadata dictionary (category, difficulty, etc.)
